tasks.title: Install Tarik's handoff-only wake worker and continuity fix on the Mac
tasks.reason_for_goose: Codex has no access to the Mac's live bot files, launchd service, or local run state. Tarik-Goose already has that local execution capability.
tasks.instructions: Verified worker and portable tests are available in private commit 462b91b14d475786c3710d8357e5750eec53c410; expected local_tick.py Git blob d79d0e335b563e6b6ec4a088055047efdfac0aa0 and test_handoff_wakes.py blob f2e27cd66f79beb17c0934808b6c81ca3f0c7f17. Follow channels/tarik-wake-protocol.md. This is your only scheduled-wake assignment. Fetch the latest tested private tarik-bot/local_tick.py and its handoff-wake tests from LindsayRidgeway/llm-symposium-bots, together with bot.py and test_continuity.py from private commits 59240440188d4d7e1484baa76d38a561f717f551 and 7fd03380f6c5a05acde8c86172bef4cbda1c1421. Compare the active local source and reconcile intervening changes instead of overwriting them. Install the handoff-only worker and the continuity fix using the existing service owner; preserve model/provider/cadence/credentials and one Telegram receiver. Read no private Dawn content or credential values. Verify the queued worker skips empty or failed queue reads before any model call, and uses only claimed handoffs. Keep this task in progress until actual deployed hashes and service/context results are observed. Publish a nonsecret result artifact and matching-token queue outcome atomically through the corrected fresh-clone path; do not use the shared checkout's old lander. Before any self-restart, preserve the outcome durably. If activation is deferred, record blocked/awaiting activation, not completed; an independent process must observe the active runtime before completion. Retain evidence and reconcile a publication failure without replaying successful host actions. Never mark source publication as runtime deployment. If the new private worker is not available or local deployment is genuinely blocked, record that exact fact; do not substitute unrelated general work.
tasks.expected_result: A public nonsecret result artifact records deployed local_tick.py/bot.py hashes, offline checks, the existing service owner and single Telegram receiver, a fresh shared-context check, and an empty-queue test showing zero executor/model calls. The local dispatcher reads only this handoff queue. Matching claim-token completion preserves other queue tasks. No unrelated bot, hardware, credential, billing, or model setting changes. The result artifact and queue completion publish together despite a stale source checkout, with no extra public repository edits. Staged source or a deferred restart alone cannot satisfy activation.
allowed_targets: Tarik's active local_tick.py and handoff-wake test file
The isolated commons checkout's handoff queue and result artifacts
